title: Pass 9 — independent re-verification round 9
lede: A final-integration session that wrote none of the stored values re-read the load-bearing facts against the live official sources on 2026-11-15, after the earlier passes. Every row below is one live fetch of an official URL on that date. Nothing was copied forward, nothing was inferred, and one new conflict was found and recorded rather than resolved by guesswork.
scope_note: Covers the three supplied link.amazon short links, the Standard Commission Income Statement, the Application Review Process, and every specification row of the three tracked products that could be read from the manufacturer's own product page or owner's manual. The parallel builds in s2/, site/, dashboard/, research/, docs/, annex-88769516/ and session-*/ keep their own verification records and were not re-checked here. Rows that this pass did not re-open keep the 2026-11-14 record unchallenged and are marked "not re-checked in this pass" in the main table above.
method: Each row is one live fetch on 2026-11-15 of the official domain the site cites for that fact. Where a value is quoted, the wording is the wording the document used. Where two official documents disagree, the row says so and no winner is picked.

new_evidence.title: The number of included accessories differs between two official documents
new_evidence.detail: The Emeril brand page says 'Included are 7 premium accessories'. The Amazon listing title for the supplied link says 'Six Cooking Accessories Included'. The owner's manual adds only that 'Some accessories may not be included with purchase', and its Parts & Accessories section enumerates 13 numbered items of which 6 are built into the appliance, leaving 7 removable accessories. The site's specification row therefore cites the two documents that support 7 and records the listing's 'Six' in the flag register, where a contradicting document belongs - a row's source list is read as the evidence for its value. The discrepancy is filed rather than resolved, because which number matches the delivered box has to be checked physically.
new_evidence.source_label: Amazon — listing title for ASIN B09B7SB46R

new_evidence.title: Three defects found in the site build itself, and fixed
new_evidence.detail: A line-by-line review of the generator found that the two decision-page pairs were wired to each other's file names: page_suggestions() declared page_rel='marketing-directions.html' while being written to suggestions.html, and page_suggestions_alt() declared 'suggestions.html' while being written to marketing-directions.html. The effect was that each page claimed the other's canonical URL, both carried the identical <title>Suggestions · Zone1 Kitchen</title>, the Suggestions page highlighted no navigation item and the parallel page highlighted the wrong one. questions.html and decision-gate.html separately carried an identical <h1>. A third defect: marketing-directions.html stated '16 suggestions' while its own table renders the parallel register's 12. All three are fixed, and a build-time check now fails on any page that nests an <a> inside another <a>.
new_evidence.source_label: This repository — the generator and its output
